messages:
lina: Heads up PR #5205 — the /v1/classify API reference has inconsistent examples that are causing client errors.
sam: which inconsistencies?
jordan: The OpenAPI response example currently shows labels as a map like {"spam": 0.96} but the runtime returns an array of objects like [{"label":"spam", "confidence":0.96}]. Folks copying the map example hit runtime errors when they try to iterate.
tanya: Oof. We originally used a map for brevity but switched the runtime to an ordered array of objects to preserve ranking and attach metadata. Docs should reflect the array.
lina: Also the request examples are inconsistent: the raw API examples show "labels": [..] while SDK snippets use "candidateLabels". We need a short note clarifying API vs SDK naming.
sam: Action items: 1) update OpenAPI example response to array-of-objects with label+confidence, 2) normalize all raw HTTP examples to snake_case (candidate_labels) and keep SDK samples camelCase, 3) add a docs test so example shape mismatches fail CI.
jordan: I'll patch /openapi/generated.yml and add a tiny test that validates example shape against the response schema (array of objects with required label and confidence).
tanya: I'll take the language snippets (curl/js/python/go) and the migration blurb. Also standardizing header examples to "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN".
lina: Current bad response in YAML (example to replace):

```yaml
labels:
  spam: 0.96
  ham: 0.04
```

Replace with canonical response example (array):

```json
[
  { "label": "spam", "confidence": 0.96 },
  { "label": "ham", "confidence": 0.04 }
]
```

sam: Example canonical curl request to show snake_case raw-API body: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/classify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-classify-1","input":"Buy cheap meds","candidate_labels":["spam","ham"],"top_k":1}'
```

jordan: Pushing the OpenAPI patch and test now. If CI finds any remaining map-shaped examples it'll fail the preview build.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, preview built for branch fix-5205 -> https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/5205
tanya: Pushed snippet updates and a short migration note: "Raw API bodies use snake_case (candidate_labels); SDKs use candidateLabels. Response shape is an array of objects with confidence scores." Preview updated.
lina: Thanks all. I'll add a changelog entry and ping support to watch for tickets from users who copied the old map example. Closing once the OpenAPI change merges.
